name: JingKong v1.0.2
body:
修复有线投屏「一键安装全部驱动」反复出现、装完卡在「等待设备重新连接…」以及重连后 iPhone 从系统消失的问题：安装采集过滤器前先释放 Apple Mobile Device Service，使设备重启不再被否决、过滤器一次装好即生效；过滤器已加载时不再要求拔插。

Fixes the wired-mirroring loop where the driver prompt kept reappearing and the iPhone dropped off the system after reconnecting: Apple Mobile Device Service is now released around the filter install so the parent restart is not vetoed, and no replug is requested once the filter is loaded.
